description: Disable password authentication for SSH on development

playbook.content:
- name: Disable SSH password auth on dev
  hosts: dev
  become: yes
  tasks:
    - ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
        path: /etc/ssh/sshd_config
        regexp: '^PasswordAuthentication'
        line: 'PasswordAuthentication no'

tier_rationale: Development host only, fully reversible, no production impact
